title: Empty or stale contribution cache
input: Bundle with zero contributions (or only closed/merged items) and the 'No contributions cached' notice.
pass_criteria: Digest explicitly states the cache is empty or too thin to report instead of inventing activity; recommends running `stead sync github` (read-only) to refresh; no fabricated PRs, issues, or CI states; header and summary still present; no suggestion to post anything to GitHub.
